    • init

      public void init(Profile profile, javafx.stage.Stage stage, SceneController sceneController)
      store profile/stage/scene controller, sets profile info in the labels, and updates recently added.
      Parameters:
      profile - contains profile that is currently being used
      stage - contains the primary stage
      sceneController - contains scene controller to navigate back to login

    • updateRecent

      public void updateRecent()
      fill all labels with the 3 most recent media entries per type

    • updateFavorites

      public void updateFavorites()
      fill all labels with the 3 most recent favorited media entries per type

    • handleAdd

      public void handleAdd()
      opens the media type selection, then opens to the correct add-entry form (movie/videogame/music artist) based on the user's choice. does nothing if the user closes the type popup without choosing.

    • addMovie

      public void addMovie()
      open addMovieView and adds the movie entry to library and refresh updateRecently

    • addVideogame

      public void addVideogame()
      open addVideogameView and adds the videogame entry to library and refresh updateRecently

    • addMusicArtist

      public void addMusicArtist()
      open addMusicArtistView and adds the music artist entry to library and refresh updateRecently

    • handleRemove

      public void handleRemove()
      opens the media type selection so user can choose which type to remove, checks that matching entries exist, then opens removeMediaView. if confirmed, removes the chosen entry from the library and refreshes updateRecent.

    • handleFilter

      public void handleFilter()
      opens displayFilterView, so the user can filter entries by status or media type

    • handleRate

      public void handleRate()
      filters the library to Completed entries and opens rateView. shows an error if there are no completed entries.

    • handleUpdateStatus

      public void handleUpdateStatus()
      opens the media type selection to choose which type to update, checks that matching entries exist, then opens updateStatusView on those entries. refreshes the recent-activity boxes if confirmed. shows an error if there are no entries of the chosen type.

    • handleUpdateDiscography

      public void handleUpdateDiscography()
      filters the library down to Music Artist entries, casts to MusicArtist to use music artist methods, and opens updateDiscographyView. refreshes updateRecent if confirmed. shows an error if there are no artists in the library.

    • handleSummary

      public void handleSummary()
      opens summaryView, which computes and displays entry counts and average completed rating

    • handleFavorite

      public void handleFavorite()
      opens addFavoriteView, then refreshes the favorites boxes once window closes. shows an error if the library has no entries yet.

    • handleLogout

      public void handleLogout()
      returns to login screen
